title: Holy Mother’s Birthday Celebrations 2021 in Belur Math
description:
Holy Mother’s Birthday will be celebrated on 05 Jan 2021 in Belur Math.
Livestreaming from 8 am.
#MaSarada #BelurMath 

Photo Gallery : 
https://photos.app.goo.gl/nvwcP6ZXMGrXUvhb8

============
PROGRAMME
============
At the Nat Mandir of Sri Ramakrishna Temple :

Matri Sangeet : 8 am to 9 am
(Monks and Brahmacharins)

Reading from Sri Sri Mayer Katha : 9-05 am to 9-45 am
(Swami Jaganmayananda)

Devotional Songs : 9-50 am to 10-50 am
(Swami Animeshananda)

Lilageeti : 10-55 am to 11-45 am
(Brahmacharins)

Discourses on the Life and Teachings of the Holy Mother Sri Sarada Devi : 3-30 pm
President : Swami Bodhasarananda (English)
Speakers : 
Swami Devarajananda (Bengali)
Swami Yajnadharananda (Hindi)

=====================
Arati of Sri Sri Thakur : 5.30 pm
Evening Arati at Mother's Temple : 6.15 pm
=====================
